notes.title: July Community Event!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’re going to do a community event! 

20 pieces of Micah Media TO UNLOCK A COOKING CG!!! (50 to unlock maid Micah but shh! It's a secret!)

This month’s theme is domesticity! Whether it be thinking about how Micah would be like as a father, how he’d cook, what he’d cook, does he fix stuff around the house, walk Skrunkly, always make sure your favorite snack is stocked up at your place, make you coffee/hot chocolate in the morning–all of that mumbo jumbo is included in this community event!

Rules:
[list]
[*] It has to be Micah’s new redesign if fanart! (I want help in getting people to notice Micah’s new design! I love the old design but I think it’s in YOUR BRAINS! So yeah! NEW MICAH DESIGN PROPAGANDA REAL!!!)
[*] Has to be in theme! (I help you brain rot, you help me brain rot!)
[*] Has to be somewhere on social media that is not this discord server!
[*] I have to see it to count it! 
[/list]

I’m sure you’ve seen me share Neii’s art around a lot! (I love sharing Micah art because it makes me happy inside! So if you’d like me to share your art and credit you, just tell me!)
Also if one video editor tells me they need any the assets for new Micah I will happily send it to you, just tell me hehe 

Join the discord! discord.gg/error143
Follow socials! https://jennyvipham.carrd.co/

notes.title: May Update!
notes.content:
Hey May What’s up?

This month we are going to be working on the SFW Day 6 to 9 sprites, the SFW 6 to 9 script, and on updating the old version of the game!  Since I’ll be working on the script, I’ll be streaming on Tiktok a lot, so if you’d like to join, follow me @jennyvipham!

The winner of the contest banner is @ᴠᴇɴ·ᴢ×0
Congratulations Vexprrr_! Thank you to everyone else who participated in the contest! It was so fun and nice to see you guys!

And you can find the fic for the art here! https://archiveofourown.org/works/46859362

Community Goals (Yay! We’re doing this again!)

4k ratings on iOS

2k ratings on itch io & steam

If we reach these goals this month you will…get to see Micah’s friend!

Community Event! Discord.gg/error143

We will also have a fanart contest on discord! The fanart that wins will be in the server banner for the month and get a fanfic based on the art by ERROR143 writers! To submit, add your picture into the ⁠error143-fanart channel and have #JuneMicah somewhere in your post so I can find it! Submissions close on May 17th and voting starts on May 21!

RULES:

1. Must be SFW

2. Must have Micah and/or Skrunkly (no OCs)

3. Must be 960x540 in size! (You just need it to be in this ratio)

4. Must be okay with me posting this on my social media for update posts or telling people about the contests! (Please attach your social media so that I can credit you!) (edited)
